ownershipPolicy: All four kinds declare declarative UI policy. Trusted controller/system evidence, controller ownerReferences, bootstrap label and reserved system names override authoring. Policy never grants RBAC permission; actual discovery, capabilities and server admission remain authoritative.
applicability: Only explicitly discovered native v1 targets. No CRD, feature gate, or additional installation. Schema/discovery does not grant create/update/bind/escalate permission. Host resolves capabilities and preserves denied/unknown/absent states.

fieldControls.control: Canonical host identity/metadata/source controls. Group never replaces metadata or annotations.
Unlimited explicit add/remove cards. Leaf writes and indexed inserts/removes preserve unknown fields and unedited rules.
Common verb toggle buttons plus advanced repeatable exact/custom verb rows; wildcard and privileged-verb consequences.
Separate repeatable token rows, exact resource plurals, empty core API group, advanced resource-name restrictions.
ClusterRole-only resource/URL union. Atomic branch change removes only mutually exclusive leaves. Local URL validation. ClusterRoleBinding-only consequence.
Direct/aggregate choice. Aggregation disables all generated-rule mutators. Direct conversion explicitly retains currently observed rules.
Repeatable OR-selector cards and shared KeyValueFields; atomic key rename and leaf edits; valid qualified keys and label values. Empty-selector wildcard warning.
Advanced repeatable expressions; typed In/NotIn/Exists/DoesNotExist choice. Existence switch atomically removes values. In/NotIn require values.

Exact Role/ClusterRole union and real metadata-only reference picker. Fixed RBAC group. ClusterRoleBinding permits only ClusterRole. All roleRef fields locked in edit. Local invalid name retained without changing canonical source.
Repeatable typed ServiceAccount/User/Group cards. Atomic kind normalization sets group and removes non-ServiceAccount namespace. External identity input never pretends users/groups are discoverable.

safety.systemOwnership: Trusted system/controller ownership, controller ownerReference, bootstrap label, and reserved system: names lock every mutator. No autoupdate annotation edits or delete/recreate.
safety.aggregation: Selectors editable, controller-produced rules inspection only. No invented effective grants or reconciliation success.
safety.roleRef: Immutable in edit. Host owns source-mode immutability enforcement; no automatic replacement.
safety.source: Canonical host AST only. Scoped atomic patch requests include session/revision. Unsupported scalar/container/union shapes return source fallback. No projected containers are serialized back.
safety.privacy: No credential lookup, logging, storage, or raw sensitive preview. Role picker requests metadata projection only. Annotations remain host-owned and never appear in group render.
safety.authorization: No bind/escalate endpoints or fake permission checks. They are authorization verbs, not subresources. Real API admission remains authoritative.
